expectations.text: Route file created at src/app/api/reports/fuel-summary/route.js exporting a GET handler
Handler calls requireAuth, wraps logic in try/catch ending with handleError, returns ok(...)
expectations.evidence: Lines 4-27: `await requireAuth(req)`, try/catch ending `return handleError(e)`, `return ok(rows || [])`.

expectations.text: Aggregation done in SQL with GROUP BY (no JS reduce/forEach over fetched rows)
expectations.evidence: Single parameterized query with GROUP BY f.vehicle_id + to_char(fuel_date,'YYYY-MM'); no client-side accumulation.

expectations.text: Groups by vehicle and month (TO_CHAR/DATE_TRUNC on fuel_date), returning vehicle plate_number/vehicle_name
expectations.evidence: SELECT f.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, v.vehicle_name, to_char(f.fuel_date,'YYYY-MM') AS month ... GROUP BY f.vehicle_id, v.plate_number, v.vehicle_name, to_char(...); JOIN vehicles.

expectations.text: Returns total liters (SUM), total amount (SUM), and average price per liter (AVG(price_per_liter) or SUM(amount)/NULLIF(SUM(liters),0))
expectations.evidence: COALESCE(SUM(f.liters),0), COALESCE(SUM(f.amount),0), and COALESCE(AVG(f.price_per_liter), SUM(f.amount)/NULLIF(SUM(f.liters),0)) — includes the NULLIF fallback.

expectations.text: from/to params are parameterized with $1/$2 placeholders and default to a wide range
expectations.evidence: `const from = sp.get('from') || '1970-01-01', to = sp.get('to') || '2100-01-01'` passed as [from, to] to $1/$2.
WHERE includes `f.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.deleted_at IS NULL`.

expectations.text: getFuelSummary() added to src/services/fuel.service.js using apiFetch + buildQuery

claims.claim: COALESCE(AVG(price_per_liter), SUM/NULLIF) handles missing price_per_liter values
claims.evidence: Line 17 uses the fallback since price_per_liter is nullable.

claims.claim: Service function exposes explicit from/to args
claims.evidence: getFuelSummary(from, to) builds query params explicitly via buildQuery({ from, to }).
